kypExtensions.rationale: Framing PDH as a five-station B-vitamin assembly line (TPP decarboxylates, lipoic acid swings, CoA receives, FAD relays, NAD+ collects) and the hub as four vitamin-handled doors is a KYP-original scaffold over the source's separate lists.
kypExtensions.summary: The relay-and-doors model that turns two cofactor lists and a pathway figure into one causal machine with arsenic and thiamine failure modes.
